title: DatasetManifest 2.0: one dataset, public or private, with its provenance
description: The single description BioSense keeps of a dataset, whatever its source. Three facts are kept apart on purpose: what kind of evidence the dataset IS (evidence_class), whether anyone may see it (visibility), and where it came from (source/accession/derived_from). A derived dataset always names its parent, so lineage is recoverable from the manifest alone. Nothing here is ever inferred when it can be asked for: a missing experimental-design field is listed in missing_metadata and blocks analysis rather than being guessed.

source.description: Where the data came from. 'derived' means this manifest describes the output of a tool run over a parent dataset. 'fixture' is a synthetic example committed to this repository: invented data for exercising the contracts, never a measurement.

accession.description: Public accession; null for private or derived data

retrieved_at.description: When the payload was fetched; null for data that was never fetched

visibility.description: private data never leaves the machine: it is not served over HTTP, not committed, and can never become a literature citation.

evidence_class.description: What this object IS. An analysis performed ON a private dataset is derived_analysis whose SOURCE is private_user_dataset; the two are never collapsed.

modality.description: Executed today: bulk_rna, cytometry_summary, generic_table, single_cell_rna (needs the singlecell extra; without it the tool is not registered and a plan is refused when it is planned) and atac_seq/chip_seq from called peaks. flow_cytometry is executed only as processed, gated tables; raw FCS is not read. The members no tool runs are still declarable, so a manifest written today stays valid when their tools land.

modality_detail.description: Modality-specific description, deliberately open so a new modality adds a block rather than changing this schema. For flow_cytometry: panel_markers, fluorophores, gating_hierarchy, population_names, compensation, instrument. Validated per modality in biosense/data/manifest.py, never invented.

conditions.description: The experimental conditions present, as the data labels them

path.description: Path as stored. For a private dataset this is under the private root and is never served.

file_type.description: h5ad and fcs are declarable now and unreadable until their Phase 2 readers land; ingest refuses them rather than pretending.

sample_metadata.description: Per-sample annotation read from the data: {column: [values]} plus sample_count.

experimental_design.description: What an analysis needs in order to compare anything. Fields left null are reported in missing_metadata and block a plan that needs them.

derived_from.description: Present on every derived dataset. A derived dataset without a resolvable parent is refused.

missing_metadata.description: Design fields that were not supplied. These are asked for, never guessed; a plan that needs one is refused and names it.

citable.description: No dataset is ever a literature citation. A literature claim requires a source, a paragraph and a verbatim quote; a measurement has none of those. Private data additionally may not leave the machine at all.
